scenes.hook: Your wireless connection can feel busy even when your internet plan looks fast. Wi-Fi seven adds another idea.
scenes.idea: Multi-Link Operation allows compatible devices to use multiple wireless links instead of relying on just one.
scenes.demo: Think of traffic moving through more than one lane, with the exact behavior depending on the hardware.
scenes.compare: This can improve reliability and responsiveness. It does not automatically make your internet subscription faster.
scenes.takeaway: Your router, device, surroundings, and local rules all affect which features you can actually use.
scenes.close: Is your bottleneck Wi-Fi or internet? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for clear tech explainers.
